The second segment, 14:17–14:29 (+2.87 km, up to 1553 m off the optimal route, stationary 4 min 10 s at a point 2995 m from pickup and 2098 m from drop-off), is not excused [F5][F2]. points.response: Correct as far as it goes: RydeTAXI metered billing means the extra kilometres are billed at the trip's own per-km rate of $1.4100 (F6, F9), and we claim exactly that — 5.67 km of billed excess = $7.99, or at minimum 2.87 km on segment two = $4.05; the driver's 'ceiling' is our arithmetic, not a defence.

The driver cannot have it both ways: the same 'Sure' (F11) he uses to claim segment one is, on his own reading, too general to cover the driven kilometres — and the reach of a consent is decided by its words and timing, not by which side it helps.

D5 proves our case, not the driver's: under RD-3(b) a stop request that names no location and produced an off-route segment whose location was never disclosed to the rider beforehand does not exempt that segment's extra_km, and 2.87 km to 1553 m off route (F5) is exactly that.

The stationary period at 14:20–14:24 (F2) is not an on-the-way stop: it is 2995 m from pickup and 2098 m from drop-off (F2), and the driver's own statement puts the shop on Beach Road (F14) — RD-3(b) leaves the segment unexempted, so the $1.08 metre waiting item (F7, F9) billed off that excursion should be waived; on the conservative reading we still claim the segment-two distance of $4.05 (F5, F6).
Agreed: nothing in F10–F14 reads as a threat, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation, so no SAFE escalation is sought and we withdraw nothing on that ground.

We do not seek a flag_account, so RD-6 is not in issue; but the driver's claim that 'the rider's profile supports no account flag against the driver' is irrelevant, and his own record — 3 disputes in 90 days, 1 upheld (F21) — is a matter for Ryde's review, not for the refund calculation.

Segment one (F4, 14:10–14:15) is not unexempt: the rider's own message 'Sure' at 14:02 (F11) was sent before that segment started and answers the driver's 14:01 proposal to go round by Cavenagh (F10), which is exactly the pre-departure consent RD-5 requires. Conceded as to arithmetic: this is metered RydeTAXI and the excess billed is 5.67 km at $1.4100/km = $7.99 (F6, F9). But RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segments' extra_km, so the rate alone does not fix the amount — the exemption of F4 must be decided first.

Correct that F11 predates the 14:10 segment (F4), which is precisely why it is valid consent for that segment under RD-5; the rider's argument that it is 'too early' inverts the rule, which only requires the consent message to precede the segment's start.

The rider asked for a stop and the driver said 'Ok' at 14:03 (F11, F12) before the trip began, so the 14:17–14:29 driving was in furtherance of a stop the rider herself initiated; whether the detour to that featureless stop is exempt turns on RD-3(b), and the stop timing/duration (F2) is charged as meter waiting under RD-3(c), not as a routing breach.
